_comment: Pinned Tectonic builds bundled as a sidecar so a fresh install can produce
a PDF without a system TeX distribution. Checksums were taken from the
upstream release assets and are verified on every fetch; a mismatch aborts
the build. To bump: change `version`, download each asset, and replace the
sha256 values with the new ones.
Tectonic is MIT licensed - see LICENSES/tectonic.LICENSE.
The shipped binary is renamed tex-viewer-tectonic: sidecars land in /usr/bin on Linux, and a file called `tectonic` there would collide with the distro's own package.

aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.note: statically linked musl build; runs on glibc systems too
